title: Splitting a finite etale marking into disjoint sections after alteration
statement: Let $g:X\to B$ be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] morphism of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] between integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] excellent [def-exc-excellent-ring] Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] schemes, whose generic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] over the generic point [def-sc-generic-point] $\eta$ of $B$ is a geometrically integral [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] curve. Let $V\subseteq X$ be the open set of points at which $g$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and let $D\subset X$ be an effective Cartier divisor (a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] locally cut out by one non-zero-divisor), possibly empty, with $D\subseteq V$ and $D\to B$ proper and etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there are an integral excellent Noetherian scheme $B_1$ and a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] surjective morphism $b:B_1\to B$ with the following properties, where $X_1=X\times_BB_1$ [def-pc-fibre-product], $a:X_1\to X$ and $g_1:X_1\to B_1$ are the two projections, and $D_1=D\times_XX_1$. (i) $X_1$ is integral, excellent and Noetherian, and $a$ is finite and surjective. (ii) $g_1$ is proper, flat and of finite presentation; its generic fibre is a geometrically integral curve; for every geometric point $\bar t\to B_1$ the geometric fibre [def-weil-geometric-fibre] of $g_1$ at $\bar t$ is isomorphic to the geometric fibre of $g$ at $b\circ\bar t$; and $g_1$ is smooth at every point of $a^{-1}(V)$. (iii) There are an integer $n\geq0$ and sections $s_1,\dots,s_n$ of $g_1$ (morphisms with $g_1s_i=1_{B_1}$), with pairwise disjoint images, such that $D_1$ is the disjoint union of the closed subschemes $s_1(B_1),\dots,s_n(B_1)$; in particular every $s_i$ lands in $a^{-1}(V)$, and $n=0$ when $D=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 0BQL (lemma-finite-etale-covering-normal-unramified), applied over the normalization of $B$ in a finite Galois extension of $\kappa(\eta)$ containing the residue fields of $D_\eta$; cf. literature/illusie-laszlo-orgogozo-travaux-de-gabber_arXiv-1207.3648.pdf, Exposé IX 1.4, p. 133 (normalized component of a base change). Integrality of $X_1$: flat base change of a geometrically integral generic fibre.
